sculpture.title: Model of a tent (.1) constructed of sticks inserted into a blue painted wooden board and covered with a loosely woven brown-beige cloth pinned into position with short wooden pins. The tent has a high peak with cloth rolled up to form an entrance, is carpeted with lace-trimmed red cloth, and has a metal brazier nailed in the centre with a pot hanger positioned over the top. Associated with the tent are three pillows (.2-4); one of striped beige and peach ticking, one trimmed with lace and one blue with blue and peach pattern. Four rectangles of cloth (.5-8) are also associated; three of embroidered cotton edged with wide lace, one with printed floral pattern and purple edging.
